Boundary behaviours recorded. Now the **sorting** control — two natural forms, identical except for how you pick the order. Both offer **Newest added / Oldest added / Title A–Z**, and both remember your last choice as your default next time.

- **Form 1 — a compact "Sort by" dropdown:** http://maker:4001/
  *(pick an order from the little menu on the right of the filter row)*
- **Form 2 — a segmented switch, like the status filter:** http://maker:4001/?sortui=segmented
  *(the three orders sit as side-by-side buttons)*

In either, try switching the order (watch the list reorder), then **reload the page** and confirm it comes back in the order you last chose.

Two things for you:
- **Which control feels better** — the compact dropdown, or the always-visible segmented switch?
- **"Remembering your default":** I made it simply *keep whatever you last picked* as the default next time — no separate "set as default" step. Does that match what you meant, or would you prefer an explicit "make this my default" action?
